title: FB-006 fail closed on unscoped rename apply paths
summary: Made rename apply fail closed when selected rows have no configured media-root authority.
reason: Worker finding FR-013 showed that direct facade callers with no _configured_media_roots produced unscoped_operator_path rows, but apply only blocked outside_configured_roots before invoking the filesystem rename service.
behavior_before: Direct rename facade apply could proceed with normal confirm_apply when no configured media roots were present, even though rows were annotated as unscoped_operator_path with review authority.
behavior_after: Rename apply now detects selected unscoped_operator_path rows and returns a warning result before calling the rename service. The existing outside-root confirmation remains valid only for rows evaluated against known configured roots.
tests_added: Added direct facade regression coverage proving unscoped rename apply rows are rejected without filesystem mutation, even when allow_outside_configured_roots is true.
Updated direct facade positive apply tests to pass backend-style configured media roots.

notes: The fix is intentionally enforced at the reusable facade boundary. Existing Local API enrichment still injects server-owned configured roots and rejects caller-spoofed backend-owned keys.
